title: The Randomized BH Procedure: A Generalized Framework Encompassing Conformal and Competition Tests
summary: We propose the Randomized BH procedure, a generalized framework that introduces randomization into the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure for false discovery rate (FDR) control. We show that the classical BH procedure as well as two recently developed families of null-distribution-free methods, competition tests and conformal tests, share a common theoretical foundation and arise as special cases of this framework.
